selected: Functional discrimination of oxygen support versus EC contact across CM developmental states
factors: Oxygen availability: two measured, noninjurious conditions chosen by pilot
EC contact: direct coculture versus physically separated ECs with matched medium/EC number
CM initial developmental state: early versus later, baseline characterized
primary_functional_endpoints: Calcium transient kinetics and contractile performance
secondary_endpoints: RNA programs corresponding to the spatial readouts
essential_controls: Donor-paired allocation; independent biological donors as inference units
Fixed matrix, EC density and culture duration
Measured oxygen; matched survival and baseline CM state
ROS/DNA-damage assessment to separate injury-associated arrest from maturation
pilot: At least four independent donor preparations per initial CM state, with treatments paired within donor; use between-donor variance to power the confirmatory study. Wells are technical repeats.
interpretation: Culture oxygen manipulates delivery conditions, not in vivo capillary perfusion; verify the in vivo correlate separately with perfused-vessel labeling/hypoxia imaging
molecular_followup: EC-specific Ptprm loss/rescue only after a contact benefit is demonstrated at matched oxygen; reciprocal CM perturbation and downstream rescue distinguish mechanism
